tokens.name: wk-color-bg
tokens.usage: Window background: the status window, the HQ main pane, toolbars, sheet footers and the ground under every component.

tokens.name: wk-color-sidebar
tokens.usage: The HQ window's sidebar column, behind its items, headings and footer.

tokens.name: wk-color-surface
tokens.usage: Raised boxes on the window: Panel, SlotCell (busy), ErrorBox, sheets, alerts, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: wk-color-control
tokens.usage: The face of default buttons, fields, checkboxes, radios, the Stepper and the selected segment.

tokens.name: wk-color-text
tokens.usage: Body copy, headlines and labels on wk-color-bg, wk-color-surface, wk-color-sidebar and wk-color-control (14.6:1 or more light, 12.4:1 or more dark); also the neutral StatusDot and the busy Pip.

tokens.name: wk-color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text (labels in FactsList, Stat captions, table headers, help lines, free-slot copy) on wk-color-bg, wk-color-surface, wk-color-sidebar and wk-color-control: 4.9:1 or more light, 5.5:1 or more dark. Source pair that misses 4.5:1: inside a count Chip (wk-color-fill-strong) on the sidebar it is 4.26:1 light, and 3.6:1 light / 4.07:1 dark when that sidebar item is selected; on a selected table row (wk-color-selection over wk-color-bg) it is 4.45:1 light.

tokens.name: wk-color-hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers: Panel and SlotCell borders, table row rules, toolbar and sidebar edges, sheet footer rule. Decorative, not a carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: wk-color-hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger rules: table header rule, Chip outline, the free SlotCell's dashed outline, ErrorBox border, the indent rule beside sheet text.

tokens.name: wk-color-control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of default buttons, fields, checkboxes, the Stepper arrows and CodeBlock.

tokens.name: wk-color-fill
tokens.usage: Resting tint laid over any surface: the Stat tile, CodeBlock, read-only fields, zebra table rows, hover on quiet controls.

tokens.name: wk-color-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed tint; the count Chip; the segmented control's track; the selected SettingsTabs tab.

tokens.name: wk-color-accent
tokens.usage: Muster's one accent: primary buttons, Link text, focus rings, selected sidebar glyphs, gauge lines and the HeatMap. As text on wk-color-bg and wk-color-surface: 7.8:1 light, 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: wk-color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and checkmarks on a wk-color-accent fill (primary button label): 8.0:1 light, 8.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: wk-color-selection
tokens.usage: Quiet selection: the selected sidebar item, a selected table row, the Stat tile's glyph square, the pressed filter button.

tokens.name: wk-color-working
tokens.usage: State only, never decoration: the working StatusDot (a job running, or finishing while standing down). As a mark it is 2.6:1 on wk-color-bg in light, below the 3:1 floor for meaningful marks; the dot's shape and the words beside it carry the state, so the source value is kept.

tokens.name: wk-color-attention
tokens.usage: State only: the attention StatusDot, the attention Chip fill, the attention Notice border and the SettingsTabs review dot. 4.8:1 on wk-color-bg light, 5.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: wk-color-on-attention
tokens.usage: Text on a wk-color-attention fill (the attention count Chip): 4.96:1 light, 6.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: wk-color-attention-text
tokens.usage: Attention words: the StatusHeadline title in its alert tone, field errors. On wk-color-bg, wk-color-surface and wk-color-attention-fill: 5.9:1 or more light, 5.8:1 or more dark.

tokens.name: wk-color-attention-fill
tokens.usage: Added for Notice: the tint behind an attention strip. Body text (wk-color-text) reads 14.4:1 light / 11.6:1 dark on it; wk-color-text-secondary 4.8:1 / 5.2:1.

tokens.name: wk-color-destructive-text
tokens.usage: Label of a destructive Button on wk-color-control: 6.8:1 light, 6.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: wk-color-thumb
tokens.usage: The thumb of a switch, on either track.

tokens.name: wk-color-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltip background.

tokens.name: wk-color-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltip text on wk-color-inverse: 16.5:1 light, 15.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: wk-color-chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series; the gauge sparklines in SlotCell. Same value as wk-color-accent.

tokens.name: wk-color-chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series (the second machine in History).

tokens.name: wk-color-chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series. Same value as wk-color-working: avoid it beside a working dot.

tokens.name: wk-color-chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: wk-color-chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series, shown only with five machines.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter, one variable file per script, weights 400 to 700 in use. Sizes are the kit's six steps; nothing in between.

styles.name: wk-title
styles.usage: The StatusHeadline title, EmptyState title and window titles (Join HQ).

styles.name: wk-title-2
styles.usage: Large secondary titles; Stat figures in a sheet use the same size.

styles.name: wk-heading
styles.usage: Sheet and dialog titles, the toolbar title.

styles.name: wk-body
styles.usage: Everything else: table cells, notices, settings rows.

styles.name: wk-caption
styles.usage: Help lines, slot text, Stat labels, notes under a group; secondary colour.

styles.name: wk-small
styles.usage: Sidebar headings and footer, chips, HeatMap months; secondary colour.

styles.name: wk-figure
styles.usage: Large numbers in a Stat row (slots busy, jobs waiting); tabular figures.

styles.name: wk-mono
styles.usage: CodeBlock, the ErrorBox raw message, join codes, host names and log lines.

spacing.note: Six steps on a 4px base; 20px is not a step.

tokens.name: wk-space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control or label pair; FactsList row gap.

tokens.name: wk-space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items: dot and its words, slot cells, buttons in a row, toolbar items.

tokens.name: wk-space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding, between settings groups, FactsList column gap.

tokens.name: wk-space-4
tokens.usage: Sheet padding, toolbar side padding, between sections in a sheet.

tokens.name: wk-space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections of a window.

tokens.name: wk-space-6
tokens.usage: Outer margins of empty states and large layouts.

radius.note: Five radii. Design radii of 1.5, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11 and 12px snap to these.

tokens.name: wk-radius-small
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, Pips, HeatMap cells, the SlotCell Stop link's hover area.

tokens.name: wk-radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, the copy icon button, fields, segmented control, sidebar items, CodeBlock, SettingsTabs.

tokens.name: wk-radius-group
tokens.usage: Panel, SlotCell, ErrorBox, Notice, Stat tile, settings groups.

tokens.name: wk-radius-window
tokens.usage: Windows, Sheet bottom corners, Alert, popovers.

tokens.name: wk-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, switches.

shadow.note: Four elevations from the kit; darker and stronger in the dark theme.

tokens.name: wk-shadow-control
tokens.usage: Resting buttons, checkboxes, radios and selects.

tokens.name: wk-shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The selected segment and the switch thumb.

tokens.name: wk-shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips and popovers.

tokens.name: wk-shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Sheet and Alert.

size.note: Control heights, rule widths and fixed widths from the kit, plus one added dot size.

tokens.name: wk-control-height
tokens.usage: Default Button, field, select, sidebar item and Stepper height.

tokens.name: wk-control-height-small
tokens.usage: Small Button, segments, the SlotCell Stop link's hit area.

tokens.name: wk-hairline-width
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: wk-focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width (solid wk-color-accent).

tokens.name: wk-focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring; also the gap in the working dot's halo.

tokens.name: wk-dot-size
tokens.usage: StatusDot at md (StatusHeadline, tables, legends) and the Pip square.

tokens.name: wk-dot-size-small
tokens.usage: Added for StatusDot sm: the dots beside sidebar items and the toolbar's connection words.

tokens.name: wk-sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The HQ window's sidebar column.

tokens.name: wk-inspector-width
tokens.usage: A three-pane layout's inspector column (kit; unused by Muster today).

fontSize.note: Six steps. Off-scale design sizes (10.5, 11.5, 12.5, 14, 22px) snap to the nearest step, ties going up.

tokens.name: wk-font-size-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, sidebar headings and footer, HeatMap labels, SettingsTabs labels.

tokens.name: wk-font-size-sm
tokens.usage: Captions and help, SlotCell text and gauges, Stat labels, CodeBlock, small buttons.

tokens.name: wk-font-size-base
tokens.usage: Body text, buttons, tables, FactsList, Notice and ErrorBox body.

tokens.name: wk-font-size-md
tokens.usage: The StatusHeadline line, sheet and dialog titles, the toolbar title.

tokens.name: wk-font-size-lg
tokens.usage: Stat figures in sheets and tiles.

tokens.name: wk-font-size-xl
tokens.usage: The StatusHeadline title, EmptyState title, Stat-row figures.

tokens.name: wk-font-weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body text and asides.

tokens.name: wk-font-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Buttons, field labels, tabs, segments.

tokens.name: wk-font-weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Headings, selected sidebar items, Stat figures, chips.

tokens.name: wk-font-weight-bold
tokens.usage: The toolbar title only.

tokens.name: wk-line-height
tokens.usage: Body text everywhere.

tokens.name: wk-line-height-tight
tokens.usage: Titles and headings.

font.note: The kit's font stacks and features as custom properties for components. The same stacks, quoted, drive the Typography view (families sans and mono). The kit's --wk-font-features ("cv11", "ss03") needs quoted strings, which this grammar does not allow, so bundle.css sets it directly.

tokens.name: wk-font-family
tokens.usage: Every component's text; set on .wk-root.

tokens.name: wk-font-family-mono
tokens.value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
tokens.usage: CodeBlock, ErrorBox raw text, .wk-mono values (host names, join codes, machine identity).

opacity.note: Added for HeatMap: five steps of wk-color-accent, from no jobs to the most.

tokens.name: mu-heat-0
tokens.usage: HeatMap cell with no jobs that day.

tokens.name: mu-heat-1
tokens.usage: HeatMap cell, a few jobs (1 to 4).

tokens.name: mu-heat-2
tokens.usage: HeatMap cell, 5 to 8 jobs.

tokens.name: mu-heat-3
tokens.usage: HeatMap cell, 9 to 12 jobs.

tokens.name: mu-heat-4
tokens.usage: HeatMap cell, 13 jobs or more.
